tasks.label: Publish to GitHub
tasks.command: bash -lc 'set -e; git add -A; if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then git commit -m "feat: initial Pomodoro app with i18n, tasks, inbox, achievements, review, ambient sound, journey panel, and API"; fi; current_branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); if [ "$current_branch" != "main" ]; then git branch -M main; fi; if git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then git remote set-url origin https://github.com/TranMaiTienDat/Pomodoro-Web.git; else git remote add origin https://github.com/TranMaiTienDat/Pomodoro-Web.git; fi; git push -u origin main'
